    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full-width non-background row acts as the alignment line.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    line_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != bg]
    if not line_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    lr = line_rows[0]
    line_color = grid[lr][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the non-background, non-line object.
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and not (r == lr and grid[r][c] == line_color)]
    if not coords:
        return out
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in coords), max(r for r, c in coords)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in coords), max(c for r, c in coords)
    obj = {(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in coords}
    above = bottom < lr
    new_top = lr - (bottom - top) - 1 if above else lr + 1
    dr = new_top - top
    for r, c, _ in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg

        out[r + dr][c] = color

    trail_r = new_top - 1 if above else new_top + (bottom - top) + 1
    if 0 <= trail_r < h:
